description: A zero-login, real-time AI training and knowledge-exchange platform for enterprise teams, including live sessions, timed polls and quizzes, a 3-Lens lab, replayable JSON Field Logs, modular timed training blocks, BYOK-grounded HKU Lunch Rotator, and optional Leaflet/OpenStreetMap field-testing map.

questions.question: Build the full Lightfield training platform: LIGHTFIELD // HKU AI Fieldwork & Knowledge Exchange header; presenter and participant experiences; QR/link joining with autogenerated participant UUID and HKU-themed alias; live status and session dropdown labelled Field Logs; replay/self-paced browsing of prior JSON sessions; duration-scalable timed curriculum blocks (POLL, QUIZ, CONCEPT, LAB_3_LENS, SANDBOX_SPIN, HOMEWORK); real-time polls, speed quizzes/leaderboards, and equal-status Experience, Grounding, and Payload lenses; BYOK drawer; HKU Lunch Rotator with grounded restaurant results; and an optional toggleable homework/field-testing map implemented with Leaflet + OpenStreetMap, requiring no map API key. Keep the BYOK key in volatile memory only: do not persist, display in logs, or include in archives. Use plain HTTP fetch (no Google SDK) for https://apidev.hku.hk/vertexai-gemini/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent, with system_instruction.parts[].text, contents containing a user text part, generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel='medium', and tools google_search and googleMaps. Any further frontend constraints?
questions.recommendedChoice: Implement the full specified Lightfield platform and optional Leaflet/OpenStreetMap field-testing map.
questions.answer: Implement the full specified Lightfield platform and optional Leaflet/OpenStreetMap field-testing map.

questions.question: Implement the Node.js + TypeScript real-time API using Socket.IO for live rooms and presenter-to-participant state broadcast. Keep active session state in memory and serialize portable JSON Field Logs on transitions/session end; provide session listing/loading, live interaction recording, and replay without overwriting archived snapshots. Support modular 10-minute to 2-hour session templates, timed block transitions, polls/aggregates, quizzes/leaderboards, 3-Lens submissions, and the HKU Lunch Rotator sandbox. Call https://apidev.hku.hk/vertexai-gemini/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent via plain fetch (no Google SDK), with system_instruction.parts[].text, contents with a user text part, generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel='medium', and tools google_search and googleMaps. Accept BYOK only for the request, keep it out of logs, persistent settings, and session JSON. No login and no database; archives remain JSON files on the server filesystem. Any further backend constraints?
questions.recommendedChoice: Implement the full specified real-time platform with filesystem JSON archives, no database, and request-scoped BYOK.
questions.answer: Implement the full specified real-time platform with filesystem JSON archives, no database, and request-scoped BYOK.
